notes: It is the map for a multiplayer horror game built for chases between players, so the genre is Survival even though the prompt asks for no mechanics at all. None of Survival's typical shapes describes a 2000x2000 stud forest, so I took world-open from the shared catalogue: one contiguous explorable map with the zones sitting on a single surface, which the answer supports by making the zones differ only in ambience and terrain rather than in threat, so world-biomes and its P4 would have been wrong. No preset survives: 1 vs All is the nearest, but the prompt bans roles and systems, which removes spawn-protected, and there is no escape gate, so only its cover-los would have carried over. The confirmed enterable cabin, watchtower and cave earn P3, the hills earn tiered, and the rivers and small lakes carry CHECK though they should clear since the water lies on one surface; I built the cave as a small enterable interior off the hillside rather than a carved overhang, so it adds no P2.
